protocol.lockAuthority: User authorized hypothesis locking in this conversation; assistant selected the explicit designs before fetching current prices.
protocol.marketDataSource: Coinbase Advanced public REST market endpoints
protocol.barConvention: ONE_DAY UTC; timestamp is bucket open; only fully closed candles; no invented missing bars
protocol.priorExposure: BTC daily 2015-01-01 through 2024-04-24 repeatedly searched; earlier total unknown. All data before study start is development/warm-up, not holdout. No use of 2024-2026 history as fresh validation.
protocol.warmup: Fixed 200-day warm-up anchored before study start; thereafter append days from this fixed anchor. Never re-seed breakout state on a shifting rolling window.

hypotheses.title: Slow trend continuation
hypotheses.mechanism: Slow adjustment of positioning may allow persistent trends; turnover must be low enough to survive transaction costs. This is a testable proposal, not an established edge.
hypotheses.signal: ON when the 20-day simple moving average of closing prices is strictly above the 120-day average; OFF otherwise.

hypotheses.title: Sustained breakout continuation
hypotheses.mechanism: New multi-month highs may accompany sustained demand; a shorter exit channel may leave weakening trends. It may fail in choppy markets and is correlated with H1.
hypotheses.signal: ON at a close strictly above the previous 60 daily highs, OFF at a close strictly below the previous 30 daily lows. State persists between thresholds; seed OFF at the first valid warm-up bar.

execution.entry: Fresh OFF-to-ON close transition only; next open. On the first forward day, treat existing ON as a fresh signal from flat. Each hypothesis starts in cash.
execution.exit: Signal OFF exits at next open; 10% stop from actual entry fill; gap stops use worse open; sample-end liquidation at final close. No leverage or shorting.
execution.sameBarRule: Protective stop checked on entry bar; stop before target; no reentry on an exit bar.
execution.paperAllocationRationale: Each entry spends 4% of its own paper account, including entry fee. At $5,000 this is $200 cash; a 10% stop with the frozen base costs models about $23.74 loss. This is not a live size authorization.

costs.basis: Explicit hypothetical research assumptions, NOT a verified Coinbase account fee. Actual user tier remains unknown.

benchmark.primary: 4%-allocated buy-and-hold from first forward open, 96% non-interest cash; same costs and final liquidation
benchmark.secondary: 100% buy-and-hold over identical dates, same costs
benchmark.tax: No tax liability assumed; report pre-tax and any separately supplied reserve explicitly.

evaluation.forwardCollection: Save each daily scan and its observed signal/time. Daily results are monitoring only. Never label a late reconstruction a contemporaneous observation.
evaluation.primaryDescriptiveQuestion: At the fixed endpoint, does each fixed rule have positive net return and a positive return difference versus the allocation-matched benchmark under both cost scenarios? Report either way.
evaluation.minimumObservations: Report elapsed years and trade count. Few trades or missing data remain inconclusive, never an automatic pass.
evaluation.inferentialVerdict: DISABLED: no calibrated next-open significance test is implemented. Do not use these descriptive conditions as statistical proof or authority to scale.
evaluation.multipleTesting: Two correlated hypotheses and two fixed cost scenarios. No picking the most favorable asset/rule/scenario after viewing results. Any future inferential family must account for all hypotheses/looks.
evaluation.earlyReview: Safety, missing data and execution errors only; no early profit-based declaration of success.
evaluation.amendments: New dated study/version only; old protocol and outcomes retained. Changes cannot inherit the original unexposed start.

riskPolicy.cashFlowTreatment: Equity and high-water mark must be cash-flow-adjusted; do not reset losses by adding money.
riskPolicy.implementation: Manual inputs and planning gates only. No access to account balances, orders or credentials; cannot enforce broker-side liquidation.
riskPolicy.gapCaveat: Stop fills, adverse gaps, outages and simultaneous losses can exceed modeled risk.

scanPolicy.universe: Public Coinbase SPOT products quoted in USD, excluding disabled/cancel-only/auction modes. Availability in a particular account is not verified.
scanPolicy.overviewOrder: 24h reported or estimated quote volume, not strategy returns; maximum 20 pages of 100 products with explicit truncation warning
scanPolicy.observationLogging: Every scan attempt and returned data range is recorded; warm-up prices viewed are no longer untouched. Market scanning does not validate a hypothesis.
scanPolicy.dailySchedule: Manual button after 00:05 UTC; one record per day plus any explicit repeated observations, no background schedule.
scanPolicy.btcHistory: BTC fetched in pages up to 200 candles from fixed warm-up anchor through most recent completed day, capped at study end. ETH/SOL use rolling 200 days for context only.

revisionNote.reason: Clarified fixed breakout warm-up anchor to prevent state from changing when a rolling window shifts. No current prices were obtained; connectivity probe timed out. No hypothesis parameters or costs changed.

digestEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 recursively key-sorted compact JSON protocol
